text:
Situation: Pegfilgrastim inventory is limited. Corvale East holds 41 units with 14.6 days on hand. Corvale General holds two lots totaling 158.06 units with 28 days and 22 days on hand respectively. The drug is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): The label for NDC 70121162701 names Kashiv BioSciences, LLC as the manufacturing plant. FDA inspection 1038740 of that plant ended on 2018-01-26 and was classified OAI, with the classification known to FDA on 2018-02-16. A later inspection 1241763 ended on 2024-06-14 and was classified VAI, known to FDA on 2024-08-16.

Our position: Current supply covers approximately one month at present usage. No FDA shortage listing exists. Alternate manufacturers have product available but their labels do not identify manufacturing plants we could verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate Accord BioPharma, Inc. supply and pricing; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to evaluate Biocon Biologics Inc. supply and pricing; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
3. Buyer to evaluate Coherus Oncology, Inc. supply and pricing; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
4. Buyer to evaluate Lupin Pharmaceuticals, Inc. supply and pricing; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
5. Buyer to evaluate Pfizer Laboratories Div Pfizer Inc supply and pricing; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes at this time.
